propositions: Derive plan-material-pin health as a nested contract alongside attestation validity, with status aggregation by severity: malformed-pin > stale-pin-missing > stale-pin-drift > current, and legacy-unpinned only for wholly absent pins.

Optional enforcement configuration with key-local fail-open policy invalidates attestations when pins are malformed, missing, or drifted; disabled enforcement reports the same observations as advisory without changing valid status.

Extend compute_validity with a PlanValidityProfile parameter (DEFAULT, CLOSE, DRIFT_REFRESH) where CLOSE and DRIFT_REFRESH disable only code freshness while retaining all other checks; drift_refresh_candidate delegates signature/kind/reopen/registry/own-material/pin checks to compute_validity(DRIFT_REFRESH) before probing code drift inline.

Parse reviewed_related_material from sidecar as PlanMaterialPin records, emit them through sidecar.build_payload during full LLM review, and validate them in resign_plan_review without calling compute_validity because no certified attestation exists in recovery.
Pre-feature sidecars without reviewed_related_material are treated as legacy-unpinned and remain valid regardless of enforcement configuration.
Every target resolution/IO/reducer failure emits structured warning plan_material_pin_target_unreadable, returns stale-pin-missing silently, and never raises past the consumer boundary.
